address_space: Ghidra image base 0x100000, not live process ASLR addresses

usb_runtime_binding.other_modes: Flag 0 also exists during init/unknown/bootloader; not all USB lifetime uses BE16.

token_decoder.escape_acceptance: Any next byte, including 7e; no canonical restriction
token_decoder.no_input: Return false while preserving parser state and escape_pending
token_decoder.delimiter_priority: Unescaped 7e resets frame parser in every state; escaped 7e is ordinary 5e

frame_parser.zero_length: No special handling; state3 increments count before equality check. Finite case only; uint64 counter wrap not exhausted.
frame_parser.capacity_guard: Store only if old count < capacity; increment count regardless.
frame_parser.oversize_condition: declared>2048 and enough ordinary body/CRC tokens, without an intervening unescaped delimiter
frame_parser.oversize_claim: CRC reads beyond configured body subbuffer; whole-object/allocation bounds and runtime outcome are not inferred.
frame_parser.crc_mismatch: Continue scanning same input; no success return, counter or dedicated log in audited function
frame_parser.crc_match: Return true, not a cloud/USB ACK and not proof of freshness

crc.coverage: body only, including opcode/flag byte; excludes length and delimiter
crc.collision_bound: No exhaustive collision proof or frequency estimate

business_boundary.dispatch_gate: Update timing/state conditions plus nonzero length; generic handler flag0 and object state2 for audited USB dispatch branch. Other flags/states follow other branches.
business_boundary.not_proved: CRC accepted frame always becomes accepted 0x3c sample; detailed payload error checks are next scope.

conditions: Slot reused and actual source RAM bytes changed
Changed byte lies beyond already-copied prefix
Write precedes that byte’s corresponding later PMA copy
